{{Quote|The spy is a blasted smuggler named Noda Lovan. Kill&mdash;I mean, make the arrest and you'll be doing the galaxy a favor. Go!|Harburik|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Noda Lovan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SmugglerTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Noda Lovan]]
Noda Lovan was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
